svg.title: Figure 1 · What a change can reopen
svg.desc: Per hazard, the linked items a change can name and how far a change spreads
svg.text: Figure 1 · What a change can reopen
Each hazard links to requirements, SSFs, mitigations and a configuration; a change naming any of them reopens the hazard (rule R10). A
change to SUS-I1-C001 reopens all 22. Spread: other hazards that share a requirement or SSF.

g.text: Terms: HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · SSF-nnn = safety-significant
software function record (safety/software/) · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-I1-C001 = configuration 001 of SUS-I1, the baseline every record applies to ·
